source_title: 'Ranabaali' box office collection day 15: Vijay Deverakonda's film earns Rs 79 cr worldwide; trails 'King - The Times of India
source_excerpt: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna's 'Ranabaali' is facing a slowdown at the box office after completing two weeks in theatres. The Telugu film has accumulated Rs 79.13 cr in worldwide gross collections. However, its latest domestic earnings indicate a further decline in theatrical momentum. The film has also fallen behind Vijay Deverakonda's previous release, 'Kingdom', in worldwide collections at the same stage.According to Sacnilk, 'Ranabaali' collected Rs 20 lakh net in India on Day 15, with screenings across 512 shows. Its cumulative domestic net collection has reached Rs 57.50 cr, while the India gross stands at Rs 66.78 cr. The overseas market has contributed Rs 12.35 cr in gross earnings, taking the worldwide total to Rs 79.13 cr.The film's Friday collection registered a 78.9% decline compared with the previous day's Rs 95 lakh. An estimated 18,453 tickets were sold on the latest day, taking the cumulative estimated admissions to 46,98,077. Its biggest single-day collection remains the opening-day figure of Rs 9.25 cr.The film's daily earnings have weakened considerably since its opening weekend. After registering a promising start, collections began declining during the weekdays. Its first week generated Rs 45.20 cr net, while the second week contributed only Rs 12.10 cr. This represents a 73.2% drop between the two periods.The third week has started with a relatively low collection. Friday's earnings added only Rs 20 lakh to the domestic total, reflecting the reduced theatrical momentum. The film will now need stronger audience turnout during the remaining days to improve its box office performance.Vijay Deverakonda's 'Ranabaali' trails 'Kingdom' by Rs 2 crA comparison with Vijay Deverakonda's previous release 'Kingdom' places the latest film slightly behind in worldwide earnings. On their respective 15th days, 'Ranabaali' collected Rs 20 lakh net in India, whereas 'Kingdom' earned Rs 3 lakh during its corresponding theatrical run in 2025.Despite the lower daily collection, 'Kingdom' had accumulated a higher worldwide gross by that stage. The film recorded Rs 51.95 cr in India net collections and Rs 60.17 cr in domestic gross earnings. Its overseas gross stood at Rs 21.25 cr, taking the worldwide total to Rs 81.42 cr. Based on the latest available figures, 'Ranabaali' trails its predecessor by Rs 2.29 cr worldwide.'Ranabaali' week-wise box office collectionThe film's first week accounted for the majority of its domestic earnings. However, its collections witnessed a substantial reduction during the following seven days.
